q: What do I have to do before replacing a hydraulic hose?

expect.contains: Isolate the machine as per SAF-SOP-003

q: A lot arrived without a material test certificate. What should QC do?
note: Rev 03 treats the test certificate as "if available"; Rev 04 makes it mandatory (HOLD). Answer from Rev 04, warn that Rev 03 differs.

q: How many samples must be inspected for a lot of 100 pieces?
note: Rev 03 (5 samples for every lot) is superseded by Rev 04 (lot-size plan). Must answer from Rev 04 and warn about Rev 03.

q: What should I check if the machine overheats?
note: UNANSWERABLE. No document mentions overheating; spindle overload (AL-305) is only superficially related.

q: What is the recommended spindle speed for the TX-200?
What is the coolant concentration for the TX-300?
note: Wrong machine model; TX-200 values must not be reused.

q: How do I perform an emergency shutdown of the machine?
note: Misleading: normal stop sequence / lockout text is similar but is not an emergency procedure.
